item.title: ESA JUICE probe targets dark Jovian moon Kallichore in 2031
item.description: Jupiter hosts more than 100 moons, with most attention focused on the four Galilean moons: Io, Europa, Ganymede and Callisto. This is primarily due to their active geology, including Io being the most volcanically active planetary body in the solar system and Europa having a vast subsurface liquid-water ocean beneath its icy crust. However, Jupiter's smaller, lesser-known moons could provide astronomers with key insights into the history of the solar system because they have remained largely unchanged, unlike the Galilean moons. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Jury hears closing arguments in Tupac Shakur murder trial
item.description: A jury heard closing arguments on Monday in the trial of a former Los Angeles gang leader accused of involvement in the sensational murder three decades ago of chart-topping rapper Tupac Shakur. Duane “Keffe D” Davis, 63, a one-time leader of the South Side Compton Crips, is accused of ordering the September 7, 1996 killing after his nephew had been beaten by members of Shakur’s entourage in Las Vegas. “Duane Davis, in the culture of gangs, could not let that stand,” prosecutor Binu Palal said.... Publicado también por: The Independent - World. Fuente: South China Morning Post.
